items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Diosa Costelo was a top name in that particular time like Chita Rivera or the other girl

ctx.x: Yes. He was a music lover and he liked to dance-Latin music, Cuban music, and Diosa Costelo was a top name in that particular time like Chita Rivera or the other girl; and she was working all over the place so he heard about Machito because she used to live in the barrio too.
